---
title: "Sensitivity to corrections and unit removal"
subtitle: "2.20 · after the postrank theory book, chapters 23 and 32"
description: "Changes in pairwise reported relations after modifying one marginal distribution or the comparison population."
---

Grades are assigned jointly, so correcting one unit's posterior—or removing a unit—can move grade boundaries and change reported relations between units whose posteriors stayed fixed.

```{=html}
<div id="app" class="prx-app column-page"></div>
<script src="../../js/vendor/d3.min.js"></script>
<script src="../../js/vendor/plot.min.js"></script>
<script src="../../js/bundles/one-correction.js"></script>
<script>window.__prxApp = PRX["one-correction"].mountWidget(document.getElementById("app"));</script>
```

## Numerical illustrations {#what-to-try}

- **Correct a mean.** Lowering C changes 2 of 10 untouched pairs (D–E, E–F).
- **No correction.** The original posterior changes 0 of 10 untouched pairs.
- **More uncertainty.** Raising A's SD under a two-grade cap changes 6 of 10 untouched pairs.
- **Drop a unit.** Removing E changes 1 of 10 remaining pairs.
- **Drop U15 from the league.** Grades shift from sizes 1, 12, 15, 2 to sizes 9, 17, 3; 107 of 406 relations change (62 newly withheld, 45 newly stated).
- **Two scores, drop C.** Equal-weight scores change 2 of 10 pairs: A–B and A–D become stated.

<details>
<summary>Marginal assumptions and excluded units</summary>

The example uses independent normal posteriors and changes only the selected marginal; refitting a model to corrected data could also move other marginals. Removing a unit keeps the remaining marginals fixed while changing the comparison population, pair count, and any recomputed expected-rank order. Excluded units are unassessed here rather than assigned the lowest grade.
</details>

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="In postrank"}
```r
library(postrank)
original <- postrank(pr_tutorial$one,tau=.2,G_max=3L,backend="highs",fragility=FALSE)
get_grades(original)
```
This reproduces the original score-A report.
:::

Standalone: [open the app](../../embed/one-correction.html), for example `?preset=league-drop`.
